name: sol_defi_lending_10
description: Same-token lend and borrow allowed in one transaction, enabling flash-loan price manipulation
question: The source file in `source` implements lending/borrowing logic that allows a user to both supply (lend) and borrow the same token for the same asset within a single transaction or block, without any check or restriction preventing this same-token lend-and-borrow pattern, thereby enabling flash-loan-based price or collateral manipulation attacks; this excludes protocols that explicitly block same-block/same-tx same-asset lend-and-borrow actions or that use oracle/TWAP safeguards making such manipulation ineffective.
criteria: deposit() and borrow() for the same asset can both be called by the same address within the same transaction with no block-based or same-tx restriction
borrow() does not check whether the caller supplied the same token as collateral in the same block before allowing the borrow
a flash-loaned token can be deposited as collateral and then immediately borrowed against within the same transaction, inflating exchange rate or share price
the contract lacks any timestamp, block-number, or reentrancy-style check to prevent lending and borrowing the same underlying asset atomically
